concept: Review and integration: what it means to think clearly under social or emotional pressure
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across questioning assumptions, spotting weak arguments, and updating your view — which is hardest for you, and why?
exercise.practice: Student identifies one real situation where clearer thinking would have helped them

assessment.success_marker: student connects at least two of the three teen-stage scenarios into a coherent personal view
